about.text: Cheese whose curd is pressed and ripened for about one to three months, firm enough to cut cleanly into slices: under German cheese law it holds more than 54 and up to 63 % water in the cheese without its fat. Germany calls it Schnittkäse, cheese for slicing; Gouda, Edam and Tilsiter are among them.

picks.why: One of France's oldest cheeses, an Auvergne PDO made for some two thousand years and a defining French cow's-milk tomme.
Menorca's famous PDO cheese, the island's defining export, paprika-rubbed and aged in square blocks.
